camel_example: aliyun edas POST /pop/v5/changeorder/co_change_group --region cn-hangzhou --EccInfo '0cf49a6c-95a8-4aa8000000' --GroupName test --AppId '3616cdca-4f92-0000000000' --ForceStatus true --header "Content-Type=application/json"
description_en: Call the ChangeDeployGroup operation to change the group of an ECS instance in an application deployed in an ECS cluster
description_zh: 调用ChangeDeployGroup更换ECS集群应用中的ECS实例的分组
kebab_example: aliyun edas change-deploy-group --app-id 3616cdca-4f92-0000000000 --ecc-info 0cf49a6c-95a8-4aa8000000 --group-name test --force-status true --region cn-hangzhou
name: ChangeDeployGroup

parameters.help_en:
The Elastic Compute Container (ECC) ID of the ECS instance whose group you want to change. Call the ListApplicationEcc operation to query the ECC ID of an application. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/199277.html.

You can change the group for only one ECS instance at a time
parameters.help_zh:
指定要切换应用实例分组的ECS实例的ECC ID。可以调用ListApplicationEcc来查询应用的ECC ID，具体操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/199277.html。

一次仅支持切换一个ECS实例到其他应用实例分组
parameters.name: ecc_info

parameters.help_en: The name of the application group, such as \`group\_a\` and \`group\_b\`. The GroupName for the default group is `_DEFAULT_GROUP`. The name can be up to 64 characters long
parameters.help_zh: 应用分组名称，例如：group_a、group_b。默认分组的GroupName为`_DEFAULT_GROUP`。长度不操作64个字符
parameters.name: group_name

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to force the change when the deployment package version of the ECC is different from the deployment package version of the application group
parameters.help_zh: ECC的部署包版本和应用分组的部署包版本不一致时是否强制更换
parameters.name: force_status
